  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CorridorCarver
    Second generation step: connects rooms with L-shaped corridors and then turns suitable wall openings into doors.
    DungeonGenerator
    Builds a random floor for a depth from a seed.
    FixedFloorSource
    A FloorSource that serves a fixed list of hand-drawn layouts, one per depth starting at depth 0.
    FixedLayouts
    Hand-drawn floor layouts.
    FloorValidator
    Checks that a generated floor is playable.
    GameFactory
    Creates fully configured game sessions.
    LootPlacer
    Scatters items and gold across a generated floor.
    MonsterPopulator
    Places the starting monsters on a generated floor.
    ProceduralFloorSource
    The standard dungeon: the hand-drawn Atrium at depth 0, generated floors from depth 1 to 9, and the hand-drawn Sanctum at depth 10.
    ResidentPlacer
    Places the hand-picked characters of the Halls: the Atrium's residents, Warden Deng, the three zone bosses, and the Hollow Registrar.
    RoomDecorator
    Third generation step: decides what each room is for, decorates interiors, and places the staircases.
    RoomPlacer
    First generation step: scatters non-overlapping rectangular rooms across an empty floor and carves out their interiors.
    TrapPlacer
    Hides traps on a generated floor: on plain floor tiles in corridors and ordinary rooms, never in the entrance room or within TrapPlacer.SAFE_RADIUS tiles of the arrival point, and never on stairs.
    TutorialFloorSource
    The Orientation tutorial ("level 0"): a single hand-drawn floor of five rooms, each with signs that explain one part of the game.
